title: 龙洲经讯Tilly Zhang：政策一致性如何随市场调整？
speaker: Tilly Zhang

segments.en: And I think the one thing it brings back to is maybe during 2022 is when they talked about how the regulatory policy should remain consistent with macro policy.
segments.zh: 我认为这让人回想起2022年，当时他们谈到监管政策应与宏观政策保持一致。

segments.en: Can you explain a little bit more the meaning of consistency and does that sort of meaning change now or is it basically the same?
segments.zh: 您能解释一下一致性的含义吗？这种含义现在是否改变，还是基本不变？

segments.en: Well the consistent of policy is a political language. It basically means like to make policies like adjust your policy based on market reality.
segments.zh: 政策一致性是一种政治语言，基本上意味着根据市场现实调整政策。

segments.en: In the past, it probably means like when the market, when the economy is down, don't make your policy too harsh to ruin the market confidence. But like now when the market confidence getting restored and the economy gets slightly better, you probably want to build more future policies to improve the future market environment.
segments.zh: 过去可能意味着当市场和经济下行时，政策不要太严厉以免破坏市场信心。但现在市场信心恢复、经济略有好转，你可能需要制定更多未来政策来改善市场环境。

segments.en: So like I think from the regulator perspective, make a consistent policy is like it's being adjusted over time, so make appropriate policy consistent with your economy environment.
segments.zh: 所以从监管者角度看，制定一致的政策就是随着时间调整，使政策与经济环境相适应。
